# libfvad source import

This directory contains an unmodified source import from
https://github.com/dpirch/libfvad at commit
`532ab666c20d3cfda38bca63abbb0f152706c369`.

Only the public header and source files required by the fixed-frame VAD are
included. Build-system files, examples, and tests from upstream are omitted.
See `LICENSE` in this directory and the SDK-level `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
